results.title: GLEIF (Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation)
results.snippet: The Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF) is a non-profit organisation founded in Basel, Switzerland in 2014 that oversees the global system for issuing and managing Legal Entity Identifiers (LEIs). It operates under the oversight of the LEI Regulatory Oversight Committee (LEI ROC).

results.title: What Is GLEIF and How the Global LEI System Works
results.snippet: GLEIF stands for the Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation. It was established in June 2014 as a not-for-profit organization to support the implementation and use of the LEI. That timing matters because the LEI did not appear as a standalone market product.

results.title: About GLEIF
results.snippet: Established by the Financial Stability Board in June 2014, the Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF) is tasked to support the implementation and use of the Legal Entity Identifier (LEI).
